Welcome to Biology! I'm Mr. Chitwood, and I'll be your instructor for this year-long required science course. We'll explore life at many scales, from the cells that make up living things to the ecosystems they inhabit. In hands-on labs, you'll learn to work safely, ask scientific questions, and use evidence to explain what you find.

## Course materials

Check CougarNet for assignments and Google Classroom for course content.
